sources.name: anac_partecipanti
sources.notes: ANAC's WAF blocks GET requests that contain a query string (e.g. ?id=...). package_show must be called with POST + JSON body. Test manually with the check_source.py helper before relying on this.

sources.notes: Generic scraper: fetches the page, finds every <a href> link ending in one of file_extensions, and downloads any that are new. Good template for other 'plain' download-listing websites.
